skill.summary: 从BOSS直聘沟通列表筛选符合全日制本科、2-8年经验、主用React且优先熟练AI工具的候选人简历。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 筛选沟通简历 Skill:

- Enables filtering of candidates from BOSS直聘 chat list based on strict recruitment requirements.
- Strictly checks education (full-time bachelor’s only), work experience (2–8 years), and primary tech stack (React).
- Prefers experience with AI tools (e.g., cursor, Claude, LLMs, Copilot).
- Guides users through step-by-step candidate screening and data collection.
- Results are sent to the user via DingTalk.
